context_scope: Long contexts contain unique deterministic synthetic supporting records; this is an acceptance study, not a real-world retrieval/task-accuracy benchmark. Record templates are shared across families.

families.task: Implement a Python disjoint-set union structure supporting snapshot and rollback. State which optimizations are safe, provide the implementation and focused tests, and explain time and space bounds.
Implement an incremental CSV parser in Python that accepts arbitrary string chunks, quoted fields, escaped quotes, CRLF and embedded newlines. Explain how state persists across chunks and give tests.
Design and implement a small Python job scheduler that respects per-tenant concurrency limits and rotates fairly among ready tenants. Explain cancellation and completion races and give tests.
Implement a trie-based autocomplete index in Python supporting insert, removal, prefix search and deterministic top suggestions. Explain invariants and complexity, including shared prefixes.
Implement cursor-based pagination over records sorted by timestamp and unique ID. Explain duplicate timestamps, concurrent inserts and deletes, and give a Python implementation with tests.
Implement a thread-safe token-bucket rate limiter in Python using a monotonic clock. Inject the clock for deterministic tests and explain bursts, clock advancement and nonblocking rejection.
Implement a Python dependency planner that returns a deterministic topological order or a concrete cycle. Handle disconnected nodes and duplicate edges. Give code, tests, invariants and complexity.
Implement an exact sliding-window median in Python using two heaps and lazy deletion. Explain balancing and duplicate values, and include tests that repeatedly expire the current median.
Prove that n cubed minus n is divisible by six for every integer n, using two independent arguments. Explain the role of consecutive integers and address negative n.
Explain inclusion-exclusion for three finite sets, prove the formula using element multiplicities, and give a worked numerical example with consistent intersections.
Prove the midpoint inequality for the square function, extend it to weighted averages, and explain its equality cases and its relation to variance.
Explain the binary greatest-common-divisor algorithm. Prove the transformations, work through gcd(462,1071), and give pseudocode with a termination argument.
Derive the finite geometric-series formula and use it to establish convergence when the absolute ratio is below one. Explain exceptional cases and provide numerical examples.
Give a rigorous proof that any n+1 integers contain two whose difference is divisible by n. Then discuss why replacing n+1 by n fails, with examples.
Derive the extended Euclidean algorithm and use it to find the multiplicative inverse of 37 modulo 101. Verify the result and explain when such an inverse exists.
Count shortest lattice paths from (0,0) to (7,5) that avoid (3,2). Derive the counting method, show the arithmetic, and explain how to generalize to two forbidden points.
